name: Adaptive shrinkage (ash)
model_likelihood: Independent normal effect-estimate likelihood conditional on estimated standard errors; optional conditional t approximation
prior: Point mass at zero plus a fixed-grid mixture of zero-centered normals (ash.n), symmetric uniforms (ash.u), or half-uniforms (ash.hu); optional scaled-effects prior beta_j/s_hat_j^alpha ~ g
inference_algorithm: Estimate mixture weights by penalized marginal likelihood using convex interior-point optimization or EM; compute conditional posterior mixtures analytically
estimand: Posterior effect distributions and intervals; local FDR; local false sign rate; subset-average sign-error rate and s-values
data_input: Effect estimates and corresponding estimated standard errors; known degrees of freedom for t extension; z scores suffice for fitted g and lfsr at alpha=1

tunable_settings: Component family; finite component scale or endpoint grid and density; penalty lambda (default lambda_0=10, others 1); alpha specified or likelihood-tuned
